saying: Most commenters said prespecifying every future modification is unworkable for generative systems and asked FDA to reframe PCCPs around limits that must hold: locked benchmarks and acceptance thresholds, deviation bounds, monitoring, rollback, and triggers for a new submission. Many also asked for tiered change categories and specific provisions for third-party foundation model updates.

disagreement.text: Commenters split on how much change can be handled inside the sponsor's quality system: some want every material change independently verified before deployment, while others want tiers permitting documentation-only or quality-system-managed changes, including like-for-like model version upgrades, without new submissions.

sides.summary: Every material change should be independently revalidated or verified before release.
Lower tiers should allow documentation-only or quality-system-managed changes, including like-for-like model upgrades, without repeat submissions.
